args.question: Acme Supplies invoice INV-75988 is approved for $14,451.60 (due 2026-11-04). Payments over $10,000 require controller approval. Please have the controller approve paying this invoice in full by wire from the operating account. I will send the wire only after approval and will pay it once. (If wire is unavailable, ACH is the fallback.)

trace.final:
I paid Acme Supplies invoice INV-75988 in full by wire, for $14,451.60. The payment ID is PAY0001, and it is verified as sent.

Because the amount is over $10,000, I requested controller approval first, and the request came back approved. I sent the wire once, using an idempotency key so it could not be executed twice.

I did not touch Acme's other invoices: INV-10168 is a draft awaiting approval, and INV-80186 was already paid.
